mapping_proof_boundary.row_crossing_rule: For base bank b, banks 0..b-1 use base_row+1 and banks b..15 use base_row.
mapping_proof_boundary.logical_rotation: logical offset i selects bank (base_bank+i) mod 16

parameter_attacks.vcs_fatal_process_rc_note: VCS maps the time-zero production-geometry $fatal/$finish to process RC 0; the exact fatal site and message are the rejection evidence.
parameter_attacks.safe_interpretation: The parameter list documents the frozen production geometry; it is not a synthesis-safe general parameterization. Exact production parameters are required.

port_cut_attack.safe_interpretation: M134 proves address generation and combinational rotation assuming bank_words already correspond to the requested rows. It cannot prove or enforce macro latency, same-request alignment, per-bank skew, or response identity.

exact_sha_logic_only_dc.safe_use: The exact-SHA result costs only the combinational legality/address/rotation port cut. It is not the delay, area, energy, or throughput of the sixteen SRAM banks or the complete registered 512-bit frontend.

P1.title: The physical 16-bank response path and request/response identity are not implemented
P1.evidence: M134 exposes combinational row addresses and accepts an untagged 512-bit bank_words bus. It has no response valid, row/bank tags, SRAM read latency, alignment registers, or skew handling. An independent stale/skewed-data injection remained legal and was rotated without detection. The DC run contains zero SRAM macros.
P1.required_fix: Instantiate or model sixteen realizable 230x32 banks, register the request identity across actual macro latency, align all bank responses, and verify address-to-macro-to-rotation timing plus stale/skew fault behavior. Until then claim only conflict-free logical mapping.

P2.title: Sixteen banks are not free relative to the eight-bank organization
P2.finding: The mapping removes a second read per bank by doubling bank count, but no matched eight-bank versus sixteen-bank macro area, periphery, wire, latency, or energy comparison exists.
P2.required_fix: Add foundry macro or CACTI-backed matched organizations including decoder/periphery/wiring and report area, access time, dynamic/leakage energy, and utilization.

P2.title: The parameter guard is simulation-only and internal geometry is hardcoded
P2.finding: Five nonproduction geometries trigger the simulation initial guard, but SYNTHESIS removes it. A BANKS=8 synthesis-define test elaborated and produced an unknown modulo-16 data selection. Constants and slices retain 16, 13, [3:0], [11:4], 16'hffff, and 4'hf assumptions.
P2.required_fix: Make the module nonparameterized for the frozen production geometry, or derive every width/mask/modulo and add synthesis-time static checks for supported parameter combinations.

P2.title: Unknown request base does not make request_legal fail closed in four-state simulation
P2.finding: With request_valid=1 and one X bit in logical_base_word, request_legal remains X while downstream outputs stay quiet. This is not a proven two-state silicon functional error, but it weakens X-propagation and fail-closed verification.
P2.required_fix: If X-safe simulation is required, explicitly qualify known request payload or assert that logical_base_word is known whenever request_valid is high.

P2.title: The exact 3 ns result is a warning-bearing virtual-clock combinational port cut
P2.finding: DC reports 2 VER-318 signedness warnings and 17 precompile LINT warnings. The 2,054.56 um2 and 0.9553 ns arrival cover 3,808 combinational cells under ideal virtual clock and ZeroWireload, with zero sequential cells and zero macros.
P2.required_fix: Resolve or waive signedness/LINT warnings and use registered macro-inclusive timing before reporting Fmax, physical throughput, or PPA.

paper_safe_statement: Exact-SHA commercial VCS plus an independent exhaustive test verify every legal 16-word base window of the fixed 3,680-word image: modulo-16 striping selects all sixteen banks exactly once, all 58,640 physical addresses stay within rows 0..229, 3,435 row crossings follow the dual-row rule, and all 58,640 logical words reorder exactly. All 431 illegal 12-bit bases quarantine. Exact-SHA TSMC28 DC costs the combinational mapper at 2,054.56 um2 with 0.9553 ns critical data arrival and positive fixed-3ns setup/hold slack. Sixteen SRAM macros, registered response alignment, macro/periphery/wire cost, matched 8-vs-16-bank PPA, power, physical speedup, system speedup, and headline claims remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not call mathematical one-read-per-bank mapping a fabricated or latency-verified 16-bank SRAM frontend.
Do not call sixteen banks free relative to eight banks.
Do not call 2,054.56 um2 the macro-inclusive area.
Do not call 0.9553 ns mapper data arrival complete frontend latency or Fmax.
Do not claim energy, physical speedup, system speedup, FPS, DATE headline, or best-paper readiness from M134.
